_why: What tools/cleanup.py may remove, and after how long. AUTO classes lose nothing — merged commits live on the default branch, pushed ones on the remote, build output is regenerated — and run on every tick when `features.auto_cleanup` is true. MANUAL classes hold the only copy of somebody's work; `full cleanup --apply` archives them first (bundle, patch, tarball), and never on a tick. A name matching `protect` is never touched.
